// Raw C# VSTO ribbon fixture. The .txt suffix keeps tooling from treating it as
// real C# source. Named ribbon-extensibility cases plus a comment trap are
// included. No consumer identifiers appear.

using System;
using Microsoft.Office.Core;

namespace Sample.Ribbon
{
    // Trap: ribbon-shaped text inside a comment must NOT match after stripping.
    // This class pretends to implement IRibbonExtensibility and GetCustomUI.

    // Bare interface implementation.
    public class BareRibbon : IRibbonExtensibility
    {
        // GetCustomUI is the single method of IRibbonExtensibility.
        public string GetCustomUI(string ribbonId)
        {
            return LoadResource(ribbonId);
        }

        private string LoadResource(string ribbonId)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }
    }

    // Namespace-qualified interface implementation.
    public class QualifiedRibbon : Microsoft.Office.Core.IRibbonExtensibility
    {
        public string GetCustomUI(string ribbonId)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }
    }

    // Designer-generated ribbon model usage (bypasses GetCustomUI at runtime).
    public partial class DesignerRibbon : Microsoft.Office.Tools.Ribbon.RibbonBase
    {
    }
}
